activity.note: the cascade is a discrete-step model: a step is one synchronous update, not a declared duration, so no spikes-per-biological-second is asserted here

generalization.protocol: 16 classes; readout trained on one half of each class pool, tested on the other half (novel variants) and on held-out draws from the training half (matched control)

memory_capacity.protocol: nearest-centroid on 4 train trials per class, tested on 2 held-out trials per class; capacity = largest M with accuracy >= 0.9

robustness.protocol: reference 2-pool discrimination at overlap 0.0, identical stimulus seeds at every lesion rate

sensory_discrimination.protocol: 2-pool 2AFC on stimulus pools whose overlap J sets Delta = 1 - J; nearest-centroid on 3 train trials per side, 3 held-out; threshold 0.75

sequence_learning.protocol: k stimuli injected in successive epochs (2 steps each); decode presented order vs its reversal from the concatenated per-epoch readout masks

temporal_depth.protocol: delayed match-to-sample: cue seeds, d steps with no input, probe seeds; decode matching vs mismatching probe from the final activation mask

energy.note: no per-scale energy results exist under results/energy; capability/energy (§19, M14) cannot be computed from this work-stream's outputs alone

protocol.dynamics: synchronous threshold cascade (flyscale.propagation.cascade): fire iff synapses arriving from the previous step's active set >= relative_threshold x mean synapses per connection in that graph
protocol.readout: binary final activation mask over readout_fraction x N neurons drawn with a fixed seed; nearest-centroid classifier (analytic, no training loop)
